messages.content: goroutine count on the validators is a staircase up and to the right since the peer churn

messages.author: grace
messages.content: pprof: ~80k goroutines blocked in eth witness request path, parked on per-request channels

messages.author: frank
messages.content: looks like doWitnessRequest never returns when the peer disconnects, and Cancel is never closed on the peer==nil path

messages.author: grace
messages.content: the drainer `go func(){<-doneCh}()` never gets a close either — unconditional leak. need proper cancel/close on teardown

messages.author: grace
messages.content: wrote the agreed fix shape on BOR-1 (thread a `cancel <-chan struct{}` through receiveWitnessPage -> buildWitnessRequests -> doWitnessRequest, reuse it as the request Cancel, select on it on the disconnect path) so the regression test matches — see the ticket comment
